newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian castor prices up on short covering.
newsitem.headline: Indian castor prices up on short covering.

text.p: Indian castor prices on Tuesday bounced back to 1,151 rupees per quintal from 1,148 rupees on short covering and speculative support, dealers said.
"Short covering by the leading shippers lifted castoroil prices which in turn triggered fresh interest for castorseed forward delivery," one dealer said.

Overall volumes were however low with operators expecting the narrow price range till end September. Groundnut oil was steady at a reduced level of 420 rupees per 10 kg on limited inflows of 40/50 tonnes. Demand was dull.
